name: Caroline H. Scott
bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives Caroline's married name as Cook, wife of John E. Cook (1833-1882), in the 1870 and 1880 censuses, with children from 1861. It also lists her in Stephen Scott's 1850 household (S1).
